verses.text: Ix in k'exxi k'elan, ix wilani to ay jun winh winak et'jinak jun ch'anh cuerda.
Ix in k'anb'an t'a winh: ¿B'ajtil tzach b'ati? xin chi. Ix yalan winh t'ayin icha tik: Wan in b'at wechtej chonhab' Jerusalén, yik snachajeli jantak sk'atul yet' jantak sat, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix wilan sb'at jun ángel wan slolon chi' wet'ok. Ay junxo ángel chi' ix elta ul scha'a, ha' ix halan t'ay:

Ixik t'a elanhchamel, al t'a winh kelem chi' icha tik: Ha Jerusalén, manhxo ol yal-laj yoch smuro'al, yujto a heb' anima ol kajnajxok t'ay, manhxo jantakok ol aj sb'isul heb'. Ol te k'ib'paxcha'anh nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Palta a Jehová tz'alani: Ha in ol in och hoyan t'a spatiktak Jerusalén chi' icha junok k'ak', icha muro. Ol in ch'ox in tzikikial t'a skal chonhab' chi', xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi jun ángel chi'.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in ix ex wak' saklemb'at t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal. Palta a tikne'ik, swal t'ayex icha tik: Ex aj Sion, elanhekkot elanhchamel t'a Babilonia ay t'a stojolal norte b'aj sakleminak eyajkanb'ati, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, schekan wal juntzanh lolonel tik t'a juntzanh nación ix ex pechan saklem a ex schonhab' ex tik. Ha tz'alan icha tik: Yalnhej mach tz'ixtan in chonhab' tik, ichato a snenal yol in sat syixtej. Yuj chi' a in ol wak' owal yet' juntzanh nación chi', a in ol in chek heb' ayoch schekab'ok heb' yik a heb' ol ik'anek' jantak sb'eyumal heb', xchi Jehová. Icha chi' ol aj sch'oxan sb'a stzikikial Jehová, icha pax chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to ha' ix in chekankot wal t'ayex.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal ex aj Sion, yujto ol in k'ochok, ol in kajnaj t'a he kal, xchi Jehová.

Ayik ol ujok jun tik, tzijtum nación ol jawok t'a Jehová, ol och schonhab'ok. Ol kajnajnhej Jehová chi' t'a he kal. Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyu'uj to a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil ix in chekankot t'ayex.
Ha Jehová, ol yak' cheklaj t'a sat lum lum yiktaxoni to a Judá yiko', haxo pax Jerusalén sik'b'ilel yuj.
Numk'ajokab' masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto wan skot yuj heb' schonhab', wan yelta t'a yol skajnub' yiknhej yaji.
